scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@meridian/api && npm exec --workspace=@meridian/web -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.test: npm run test:run --workspace=@meridian/api && npm run test:unit --workspace=@meridian/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@meridian/api && npm exec --workspace=@meridian/web -- vite build
